summary: HomesToLife Ltd, a Singapore-based furniture retailer listed in the US, filed a Form 6-K disclosing that it applied for a secondary listing by way of introduction of its ordinary shares on the Main Board of the Singapore Exchange (SGX-ST), the US equivalent of a direct/technical listing without new capital raise. A letter dated September 17, 2026, signed by CEO Phua Mei Ming, was sent to vendors, partners and employees. No price, stake, premium or advisor is stated; no change to controlling shareholders or management is expected. Approval remains subject to regulatory review, with no assurance of completion. Watch for SGX approval and liquidity/dual-listing arbitrage effects.
